'''''LFA 149: Bunes vs. Horiuchi''''' was a mixed martial arts event promoted by [[Legacy Fighting Alliance]] and that took place on January 6, 2023. It aired on [[UFC Fight Pass]].

===Background===
A [[Legacy Fighting Alliance#Flyweight Championship|LFA Flyweight Championship]] for the vacant title between Felipe Bunes and Yuma Horiuchi headlined the event.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.fightbookmma.com/lfa-149-bunes-vs-horiuchi-is-set-for-january-6/|title=LFA 149: Bunes vs. Horiuchi is set for January 6|publisher=FightBookMMA.com|date=2022-12-02|access-date=2022-12-06}}</ref>
